notes: The new Planner shows whether an airframe is ready for its next flight and why, including checks, parts, defects and service needs.
The Planner shows what comes due next. Dates estimated from recent flying are marked as estimates.
Checks, part work and deferred-item fixes can be booked for a date and time. Work waits until the aircraft is parked and survives TechLog being closed.
The tablet page now has ten tabs and fits their labels on narrow screens.
TechLog connects to the Fenix gateway at 127.0.0.1 to avoid delays caused by localhost resolving to IPv6.
